data.one_liner: Run shell scripts and locate executables across Linux, Windows and macOS.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a Shell class that can execute scripts in a portable way and a whichSync function that searches for installed executables. It also offers process inspection utilities such as finding running processes by executable name and killing process trees.
use_when: You need to run shell commands from a Dart/Flutter app
You need to locate an executable on the host system
You need to inspect or terminate running processes
avoid_when: You only need simple command execution without process inspection
You are targeting only a single platform and prefer a native solution
strengths: No external dependencies beyond Dart SDK
weaknesses: No async stream API for process output
Requires platform permissions for process control
